prompt: Single game hero sprite: A proud, powerful, mature male spear-warrior of the Crescent Crane order, drawn as a chunky heroic cartoon character about 3 heads tall: a BIG head about one third of the whole figure height, a massive barrel chest, huge round shoulders, enormous forearms and ENORMOUS fists (each fist almost as big as his face), short thick legs and big heavy boots, a wide planted stance, never cute, never a mascot. His face is built from the fewest bold shapes: a thick angular dark brow shape, TWO BOLD GLOWING gold-white eye shapes with no pupils as the brightest points of the face, a small light-tan nose shape, a square jaw, and a short beard drawn as ONE mid-dark shape with a lighter highlight patch; black hair tied in a high topknot with a vermilion cord, drawn as a few big solid clumps. TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH. SIGNATURE: behind his shoulder on the RIGHT side of the image rises ONE giant crane-wing shoulder guard, a fan of five overlapping ivory-white feather plates with a thick chunky gold edge band, as tall as his whole head, fixed to his armour; his shoulder on the LEFT side of the image has a smaller round blue-violet plate with a thick chunky gold edge band. His cuirass is chunky deep blue-violet plate with ONE LARGE bold gold crane emblem on the chest, ivory edge plates, a wide dark belt with a gold buckle and a hanging vermilion sash, and short coat tails of blue-violet cloth with an ivory lining and a few big torn pointed tips; a big gauntlet with a thick gold band and a gold crescent plate on EACH forearm (identical on both arms), and a thick greave and a big round boot with a slightly upturned toe on EACH leg (identical). In the hand on the LEFT side of the image (his own right hand) he holds ONE oversized long spear: a straight dark haft slightly TALLER than he is, with two ivory bands, a gold collar and a vermilion tassel just below the spearhead, and at the top ONE big chunky leaf-shaped spearhead of BRIGHT silver-white steel, as big as his head, with a large pale highlight shape and a darker blue-violet centre ridge, a thick gold crescent-moon cross-guard of two curved horns just below the spearhead, and ONE red gem at the socket; the haft has a gold butt cap; held by a huge clearly visible gripping fist at about the height of his hip; the hand on the RIGHT side of the image is empty, a huge clenched fist the same size as the spear hand. Main colour a MID-VALUE saturated blue-violet (clearly lighter than navy, never near-black), second colour GOLD used as thick chunky bands, ivory white ONLY for the crane-wing, ONE small bright accent vermilion red (sash, cord, tassel, gem); skin in warm tan. NEAR-FRONT VIEW from a high top-down camera: the body faces the viewer and is turned only about 20 degrees toward the RIGHT of the image, the face looking slightly right, the whole chest visible. BOTH ARMS are fully visible and the same size, neither hidden; BOTH LEGS are fully visible, the same size, neither hidden. Not a flat profile, not a straight front view. Standing UPRIGHT in a calm, strong idle stance: the body upright with a living pose: the head tilted about 8 degrees toward the right of the image, the left shoulder about 5% of the figure height lower than the right, both feet planted wide apart, side by side on ONE horizontal ground line, the right arm hanging down at his side away from the body; the spear stands beside his left hand with the butt of the haft on the ground line, the haft tilted about 8 degrees so that the spearhead leans toward the upper-left of the image, the whole spear clear of the legs and fully inside the frame with the tip of the spearhead at least 8% below the top edge. Full body, centered, filling about 68% of the frame height. At most four colour families. Everything stays inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Style: stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a fantasy tower defense game, in the manner of a chunky heroic cartoon hero illustration, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Chunky rounded bean-like volumes with slight squash and stretch, big simple shapes with a bold silhouette, exaggerated proportions with the hands, shoulders and the spearhead enlarged and the legs shrunk. Colour: flat solid fills in 3 to 4 stacked hard-edged tones (a shadow tone shifted toward a cooler hue, the base, a lighter tone, and one bright highlight shape on top), with the large areas kept in MID values so the figure stays readable when shrunk to 60 pixels; no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Thick clean dark brown-violet outlines (never pure black), clearly thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner for inner lines, with rounded joins. A few small flat speckle spots of a lighter or darker tone are scattered on the armour and the skin. Medium detail only: details are bold simple shapes (one emblem, layered plates, a tassel, a gem), no fine engraving, no filigree, no tiny patterns, NO thin gold lines: gold is only chunky bands and big shapes. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
